intro.text: An Allomantic metal. A Leecher burning it wipes out the metal reserves of any other Allomancer they touch.
A metal whose Allomancers drain the metal reserves of anyone they touch, and in which Feruchemists store Fortune.

description.text: Feruchemists can store Fortune in chromium, though even the Terris have only a partial grasp of what Fortune is.
Alonoe of the Ire says that drawing on Fortune can bring about coincidences.
Inside the body chromium behaves like aluminum, so any Allomancer a Leecher touches loses their metals. Being leeched brings a sudden feeling of cold.
